name: spellkave_describe
label: Describe
description: Read one admitted authored entity, its place or containment chain and admitted containment, ownership and equipment. Publisher closure and caller-scoped reads use separate sources. Scoped relationships require both endpoints; an outside endpoint is marked outside_scope without its identity or label. Answers carry source and coverage information.

key.description: Authored entity_key or numeric id of an authored entity.

bundle.description: bundle_id when the key is not unique.

promptSnippet: Describe one placed authored entity and what belongs to it

examples.description: describe the loft chest and its contents

limitations: Only scoped comparable instance kinds; explicit incomplete coverage.
